name: Husky A300
compute_detail: Standard Intel i3-13100TE; Performance Intel i7-13700TE (GPU optional)
summary: Rugged all-terrain 4-wheel skid-steer UGV for outdoor robotics research and field prototyping, shipped with ROS 2.

name: Jackal
compute_detail: Standard Intel i3-9100TE 16GB; Performance Intel i7-9700TE 16GB
summary: Small, fast, weatherproof 4x4 field-robotics research UGV with onboard PC, GPS and IMU integrated with ROS 2.

name: Ridgeback
summary: Indoor omnidirectional mecanum-wheel base for carrying manipulators and heavy payloads in mobile-manipulation research.

name: Dingo-O
summary: Lightweight, low-profile indoor omnidirectional (mecanum) base for robotics research and education; a differential Dingo-D variant also exists.

name: SCOUT 2.0
summary: Heavy-duty four-wheel-differential off-road UGV chassis for outdoor patrol, inspection, agriculture and field research builds.

name: SCOUT MINI
summary: Compact 4WD hub-motor differential base for outdoor navigation research, sensor integration and mobile manipulation.

name: BUNKER PRO 2.0
summary: Heavy-duty IP67 tracked chassis for industrial inspection, emergency response and material transport over rugged terrain.

name: RANGER MINI 3.0
summary: Four-wheel-drive, four-wheel-steer omnidirectional base for delivery, logistics and indoor-outdoor AMR development.

name: TRACER 2.0
summary: Low-profile two-wheel-differential indoor base (54–56 kg) for AGV/AMR material transport and line-side delivery development.

name: TurtleBot 4
summary: Low-cost ROS 2 education and research robot built on the iRobot Create 3 base with lidar, stereo-depth camera and Raspberry Pi.

name: Stretch 3
price_note: list price on manufacturer product page
summary: Lightweight differential-drive mobile manipulator with lift and telescoping arm for in-home and assistive manipulation research.

name: RMP Lite 220
summary: IP65 differential hub-motor chassis for indoor/outdoor delivery, patrol and AGV builds; base of NVIDIA's Carter reference robot.

name: X1
summary: Urban service robot on a 1-tonne three-wheel drive-by-wire chassis for sidewalk edge sweeping; shown at CIIE 6 Nov 2026.

name: UHA (Kom4WD) logistics robot
summary: Omnidirectional four-wheel-drive autonomous courier robot from Kompai for point-to-point logistics on open industrial and campus sites.
note: Kompai page: 180 x 93 x 165 cm (LxWxH), 350 kg, up to 250 kg load, 0-15 km/h (= 4.17 m/s), 3 h autonomy, 3.4 kW, 48 V LiFePO4 (Ah not stated), 4 driving & steering wheels (omnidirectional), laser & GPS RTK navigation, CE certified; open firmware (kom4WD/komNAV) for R&D. Outdoor site-logistics courier (deployed at Université de Haute-Alsace, hence 'UHA'), not an indoor platform. Aggregator speed of 7.2 km/h conflicts with maker's 15 km/h.

name: FOLO-300
summary: 4WD person-following heavy-duty chassis carrying up to 300 kg, LiFePO4 battery for about 5 h, for farms, patrols and equipment transport.
note: Foxtech store product page; few numeric specs published. runtime is 'approximately 5 hours'.

name: TIAGo Base
summary: Customisable ROS-based AMR base for logistics and research carrying 70 kg at up to 1 m/s with up to 10 h autonomy.
note: Round base: official 'Dimensions 54 x 30 cm' with ∅540 mm footprint, so length/width = 540 (diameter), height 300.

name: TIAGo OMNI Base
summary: Omnidirectional mecanum-wheel ROS base with two LiDARs, 100 kg payload, 1.5 m/s and 8–10 h autonomy for research and logistics.

videos.title: TIAGo OMNI Base (embedded on official page)

note: Dimensions listed as '500 x 720 x 310 mm' without axis labels; mapped width 500, length 720, height 310. runtime 8–10 h stated; lower bound used.

name: ExR-2.5
summary: Explosion-proof (ATEX/IECEx Zone 1, UL) autonomous inspection robot for oil, gas, hydrogen and chemical sites.
note: ExRobotics (Delft) product page: ATEX/IECEx Zone 1 + UL certified, -40 to +55 C, up to 2 km per charge, mission 2-6 h (runtime_h = upper bound 6), autonomous inductive docking, 4G/5G, 100+ robots deployed. Locomotion not stated in maker page text (US distributor MicroWatt calls it tracked) - left out; verify before setting Tracked. Speed 2 km/h appears in maker text seen only in a search excerpt (old /our-products page now 404), so max_speed_mps left out (would be 0.56). Weight 110-140 kg only on aggregators. Software via partner (page names Korial; older material Energy Robotics).

name: BracketBot Gen 2.5
summary: Bracket Bot's low-cost self-balancing wheeled general-purpose robot built in small batches for offices, labs and homes.
note: Maker site (bracketbot.com) has no product page or specs for 'Gen 2.5'; only a company statement. Model existence rests on the maker's X posts (1 Jul 2026: building 100 Gen2.5's; price 'less than $3000'), seen only in search excerpts, plus a later post naming 'Bracket Bot 1 Gen 3.0' — so Gen 2.5 may already be superseded. Self-balancing two-wheel (Segway-style) mobile manipulator per founder demos. Aggregator height 173 cm / $2k not maker-verified. Company HQ San Francisco (founder from Univ. of Waterloo; aggregators say Canada).

name: Pickle Unload System
summary: Pickle Robot's mobile truck- and container-unloading robot that picks floor-loaded boxes onto conveyors, run by the Dill Autonomy Engine.
note: RENAME: 'Dill' was the robot's 2021 launch name; the maker now sells the 'Pickle Unload System' (truck unloading robot) and uses 'Dill' only for the 'Dill Autonomy Engine' software. Wheeled mobile base with industrial arm + suction gripper; drives itself deeper into the trailer. Maker states 400-1,500 cases/h, packages 6x6x6 in to 24x24x32 in up to 50 lb (22.7 kg -> payload_kg), setup <5 min dock to dock. 2021 launch press said peak 1,600-1,800 picks/h and 25 kg (KR30 version) — older figures.

name: Mech
summary: Dexterity's wheeled two-armed industrial robot for truck loading, unloading and palletizing in logistics facilities.
note: Wheeled dual-arm 'industrial superhumanoid': four-wheel-steerable rover base (moves, spins, strafes, climbs ramps) with two Kawasaki-built arms. Maker states 5.4 m armspan, 60 kg combined lift (Kawasaki release: 30 kg per arm), vertical reach >2.4 m, up to 16 cameras plus LiDAR, onboard 'supercomputer', operating 0-50 C, up to 1,500 m altitude (homepage says 5000 ft — minor conflict). Launched 17 Mar 2025; deployed for FedEx trailer loading and Sagawa Express validation.

name: KMR iisy
summary: KUKA autonomous mobile cobot combining a SLAM-navigating platform (up to 200 kg) with an LBR iisy arm for machine tending, pick-and-place and cleanroom logistics.
note: Mobile manipulator: differential-drive platform plus integrated LBR iisy 6-axis cobot (11 or 15 kg arm payload). payload_kg = platform capacity 200 kg (my.KUKA lists rated payload 200 kg for KMR iisy-2; a CR C+ variant lists 100 kg). Dimensions/weight from KUKA's my.KUKA product page for KMR iisy-2 (1120 x 695 x 700 mm, 425 kg, 8 h max operating time) - seen in search excerpt of the maker portal, not opened; main product page (opened) confirms 695 x 1120 mm platform, 1.5 m/s, IP54, ISO cleanroom class 3. Launched 2023 (press release July 2023). dof = 6 (arm only).

name: RB-VOGUI+
summary: Outdoor omnidirectional mobile manipulator combining Robotnik's RB-VOGUI base with a Universal Robots arm for agriculture and construction R&D.
note: Robotnik datasheet (2023, UR arm version). Weight = 165 kg base + 20.6 kg arm. Newer 2026 datasheet lists UR7e/UR8/UR12e variants at 1044x776x742 mm, 130/105/115 kg payload, IP53.

name: RB-KAIROS+
summary: Indoor omnidirectional mobile manipulator integrating a Universal Robots e-Series arm on a 250 kg-payload mecanum platform.
note: Robotnik 2024 datasheet, UR5e version (UR16e version 1410 mm tall, 153 kg). Weight = 115 kg base + 25 kg arm.

name: TIAGo
summary: Modular ROS-based mobile manipulator with lifting torso and 7-DoF arm, widely used for research and service robotics.
note: PAL product page, 2024 datasheet and PAL OS docs. Height = top of torso-lift range (110-145 cm); footprint Ø54 cm used for length/width. Weight 70 kg (datasheet; docs list 60-72 kg by config). Runtime 4-5 h with 1 battery (8-10 h with 2), lower bound used. DoF 12 = base 2 + torso 1 + arm 7 + head 2.

name: KMR iiwa
summary: Autonomous HRC-capable mobile robot combining KUKA's LBR iiwa 7-axis cobot with an omnidirectional Mecanum-wheel platform.
note: KUKA brochure: platform 700 x 1080 x 630 mm (H x L x W incl. scanners), 390 kg, payload 170 kg with LBR iiwa (200 kg without). my.KUKA lists omniMove C+ variants (181 kg payload, 1849x1445x2001 mm, 8 h) 'only available till 31.12.2026'. dof = 7-axis LBR iiwa arm.

name: Fetch Mobile Manipulator
compute_detail: Intel i5 Haswell, 16 GB RAM, 120 GB SSD
summary: ROS-based research mobile manipulator with telescoping torso, 7-DoF arm and pan-tilt head for indoor manipulation research.
note: Fetch Robotics official docs (docs.fetchrobotics.com) + Fetch spec sheet (copy on reseller host). Footprint 508 mm wide / 559 mm dia. Height = torso up. dof 13 includes base. Current availability under Zebra not stated.

name: Human Support Robot (HSR)
summary: Compact omnidirectional home-assistance mobile manipulator from Toyota that picks up and fetches objects for elderly and disabled users.
note: Toyota official: 2015 'new HSR' specs (first HSR announced 2012 with 370 mm body, 32 kg). Height = top of 1005-1350 mm range; body diameter 430 mm used for length/width. Provided to HSR Developers' Community research partners.

name: rob@work 3
summary: Fraunhofer IPA omnidirectional mobile manipulator platform for developing industrial service robot applications in production.
note: Fraunhofer IPA rob@work hardware page + product sheet. 103 x 56.5 cm (75 cm short version). Arm optional (UR5/UR10/Schunk/ABB YuMi). Research/development platform.

name: Stretch
summary: Wheeled mobile manipulator with a vacuum-gripper arm and perception mast that unloads trucks and containers for multiple shifts.
note: Wheeled box-handling mobile manipulator, not legged. Maker page gives no numeric specs in text.

name: Cobot Magic
summary: Open-source mobile dual-arm teleoperation platform based on Mobile ALOHA for bimanual manipulation data collection and embodied AI research.
note: Mobile ALOHA-based bimanual teleoperation/data-collection platform: TRACER 2.0 differential base + 4x PiPER 6-DoF arms. Dims = stand frame 1125x758x1507 mm. Supports ROS 1/ROS 2, SDKs, LeRobot etc.

name: Cobalt Robot
summary: Autonomous indoor security robot with 60+ sensors that patrols facilities and escalates anomalies to remote human specialists.
note: Indoor security patrol robot from Cobalt AI (formerly Cobalt Robotics); sold as a service with Cobalt Monitoring Intelligence. Height 5'1" per maker spec sheet.

name: Franka Mobile FR3 Duo
summary: Omnidirectional dual-arm mobile manipulator prototype for physical-AI research: teleoperation, data collection and policy execution.
note: Labelled 'Prototype' by Franka (early access); FR3 Duo dual-arm on Tactile Mobile Robot (TMR) base with Franka Spine lift. Prototype manual (2026) gives 1.5 m/s; earlier two-pager said 1.75 m/s. Payload 3 kg per arm (base 125 kg).

name: Stretch 4
sdk_name: Stretch ROS 2 and Python SDK (open source)
summary: Lightweight open-source mobile manipulator with telescoping arm and omnidirectional base for home and workplace tasks and embodied AI research.
note: Payload 4 kg arm retracted (2.5 kg extended). Footprint 45 cm diameter (datasheet Rev5 says 43 cm). DoF 9 incl. omnibase. Battery 512 Wh LiFePO4 swappable. Runtime 8 h at light CPU load.

name: K5
summary: Outdoor autonomous security robot patrolling parking lots and campuses with 360° HD video, thermal imaging and license plate recognition.
note: Outdoor autonomous security robot. Weight 420 lb; 64.6 x 34.9 x 44.6 in; up to 3 mph; patrol 2.5-3 h between charges.

name: K7
summary: Off-road autonomous security robot for large outdoor perimeters such as logistics hubs and industrial sites.
note: Light-duty off-road autonomous security robot for large outdoor sites; up to 10 mph per Knightscope media kit.

name: Nova Carter
summary: Complete AMR development platform with Jetson AGX Orin and 360° camera/LiDAR sensing for Isaac ROS and Nav2 development.
note: Segway Robotics x NVIDIA reference AMR (Nova Orin architecture) on Segway RMP Lite 220 differential base. Top speed stated as ≥12 km/h unloaded (3.33 used). Front wheel 11 in (280 mm).

name: LeKiwi
summary: Open-source low-cost 3D-printed mobile manipulator combining an omniwheel base with an SO-100 arm for LeRobot teleoperation and learning.
note: Open-source DIY low-cost mobile manipulator (3-omniwheel base + SO-100/SO-101 arm, Raspberry Pi) from SIGRobotics UIUC; integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot. BOM cost ~$482 (12V) / $499 (5V) US, not a retail price.

name: Argus S5.4
summary: Outdoor autonomous security patrol robot with onboard Jetson Orin NX for running third-party video analytics and AI applications.
note: Shipping from March 2026; NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX for third-party AI apps (SMP Store), dual-system design, API. Speed 4-6 km/h and IP65 are stated for the Argus outdoor patrol platform generally (max 6 km/h used).

name: Mobile AI
summary: Mobile bimanual teleoperation and data-collection workstation with four WidowX AI arms for robot learning research.
note: Trossen AI 'Mobile AI' kit (formerly Aloha Mobile): 4x WidowX AI arms (2 leader/follower pairs), 3x RealSense D405, wheeled base. Trossen docs now call it a 'previous-generation kit'.

name: M-Bot MC500-12
summary: Omnidirectional Mecanum mobile manipulator pairing a 300 kg-payload platform with a 12 kg cobot arm and 2.5D vision (±0.2 mm).
note: Official page names it 'MC500-12' (an omnidirectional mobile manipulator: AMR + 12 kg cobot), not 'M-Bot'; M-Bot is Elite's AMR chassis series. battery_wh computed from stated 48V/60Ah.
